messages:
maya: Heads up — seeing a sustained p99 remote_write latency spike and ingestion cost jump for ap-sg-gpu. Grafana panel shows queue depth rising and lots of 504s. Anyone on this region?

jon: Noted. Logs show repeated 'dial tcp: i/o timeout' from prometheus -> ingesters. NAT gateway metrics show ephemeral port exhaustion (SYN drops). Also seeing a huge increase in series; exporter churn might be creating high-cardinality.

li: I pulled a sample of the /metrics payloads — exporter is adding `container_restart_count` + `pod_name` into many metrics via annotations. Relabeling in scrape_config currently doesn't drop that. Cardinality explosion matches the timing.

rade: Quick mitigation: add a relabel_config to drop these volatile labels and increase remote_write queue capacity temporarily. Example snippet to push now:

```yaml
- job_name: kube-exporter
  scrape_interval: 30s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
      regex: true
      action: keep
    - source_labels: [container_restart_count,pod_name]
      regex: ".*"
      action: labeldrop
  remote_write:
    - url: https://ingest.redwood.internal/api/v1/write
      queue_config:
        capacity: 5000
        max_shards: 200
```

sre-bot: Incident INC-4521 created for ap-sg-gpu remote_write surge. Paging on-call.

jon: I'm going to silence the p99 alert for 15m to avoid alert fatigue while we roll fixes. Adding a targeted alert for remote_write queue depth > 80% for 5m so we still see pressure.

maya: Cost note — ingestion tagged ap-sg-gpu spiked ~+23% in last 3 hours. If we don't fix, this will balloon monthly. Need exporter's change as medium-term fix.

ops-bot: Starting canary of relabel change in ap-sg cluster (3 nodes) in ~2 minutes.

deploy-bot: Canary applied to 3 nodes in ap-sg-gpu. Watching metrics.

li: Also found a k8s annotation that copies podName into metric label downstream. PR incoming to strip podName and stop exporting volatile labels at source.

rade: After canary: p99 remote_write dropped from ~620ms -> 110ms, 504s fell to <1% of writes, queue depth back to normal. Cost rate trending down. Keeping canary for 30m then roll.

maya: Great. Postmortem / action items: 1) PR to exporter to whitelist stable labels (li), 2) add unit tests for metric label whitelist (rade), 3) dashboard: add remote_write queue depth per region and ephemeral port saturation panel (maya), 4) tuning: adjust alerting SLO noise and add a low-severity queue-depth alert (jon). I'll own the follow-up doc.

sre-bot: INC-4521 updated: assigned to maya/li/rade. Next update in 30m or on status change.

jon: Thanks all — nice quick triage. Once PR merges we should schedule a postmortem and cost review with finance for ap-sg GPU fleet.

maya: Adding finance tag to postmortem. Closing noise window now. :thumbsup:
